subject.title: Feature Request: Add parseMode config for Telegram channels

question: Should the Telegram plugin add a public text/parse-mode config, and which values/defaults should be supported across normal sends, captions, edits, and streaming previews?
rationale: Current code has internal markdown/html/rich-message modes but no public parse-mode contract, and exposing one affects Telegram rendering, escaping, client compatibility, and security boundaries.

options.title: Add narrow plain/html config
options.body: Support current HTML/default behavior plus a conservative plain/no-parse mode with account inheritance and coverage across all outbound funnels.

options.title: Include MarkdownV2 or raw modes
options.body: Support MarkdownV2, raw HTML, or entity modes too, accepting a larger escaping and trust-boundary review burden.

options.title: Keep existing knobs only
options.body: Use `richMessages`, `markdown.tables`, and targeted formatter fixes instead of adding a parse-mode config surface.

recommendation.title: Add narrow plain/html config
recommendation.body: Support current HTML/default behavior plus a conservative plain/no-parse mode with account inheritance and coverage across all outbound funnels.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history signal for the original HTML-formatting decision and prior parse-mode product review context.
